plan.note: progress.json is the SOLE tracker: scope, acceptance criteria, task status, blockers, app versions and UI evidence live here. docs/PLAN.md was folded into this file and deleted 2026-10-14.
plan.goal: Run three pinned Android utility apps as ordinary, persistent Linux windows: complete useful tasks, retain data across restarts, navigate screens, and run under the default isolation path. Broad Android compatibility is a later goal.
working_rules: Work from real app failures; class count, compilation and headless exit zero do not establish application compatibility.
Fix lifecycle, dispatch and isolation before expanding ABI or hardware scope.
Preserve existing installer, translator, Wayland, storage and bridge work. Prove each behavioral fix through the affected visible UI flow.
Treat missing capabilities explicitly. Fake coordinates, immediate delayed callbacks and success-shaped no-ops are not acceptable production substitutes.
Reuse a suitable host backend when it reduces maintenance, after a small feasibility test. Avoid reimplementing an entire browser or text stack.
Keep changes small enough to verify. Size labels are relative engineering scope (S/M/L/XL), not time estimates or delivery promises.

acceptance_scenarios.flow: Enter a calculation, verify the result, copy it, resize, close cleanly.
Calculate, navigate settings and back, change an applicable preference, restart and check persistence.
Create and edit a Unicode note, save, close, reopen, verify contents and navigate back from editing.

acceptance_scenarios.rule: Every app must remain usable beyond 30 seconds and pass under default confinement.
Screenshots must accompany asserted actions and saved results; a window screenshot alone is insufficient.
Substitute a candidate only with a recorded reason; do not replace a failing app merely to turn the gate green.

objective: Three pinned utility apps complete useful visible flows, preserve data and run under default isolation.

status_definitions.blocked: Requires a stated prerequisite or external change
status_definitions.deferred: Outside the active three-app gate unless explicitly promoted

baseline.readiness: Prototype; prior M0-M6 completion labels do not establish production readiness.

checks.detail: 35/35 build steps; 17 Zig test roots, not 35 individual tests.
Fresh compilation of 469 Java files; unchecked ArrayAdapter warning.
1000ms postDelayed executed in 3ms; main handler callback ran on worker; queue identity unstable; JS 2+2 returned null. Temporary probe, not a committed regression.
Repository argument shape returned EINVAL; null/zero VERSION query returned ABI 10. No confinement installed by the probe.
Historical logs are not current acceptance evidence.

blockers.detail: Key events arriving before the bridge xkb keymap is ready crash the JVM (SIGSEGV in xkb_state_update_mask; observed 3x during rapid ad-hoc probing, never on the vinput-first flow path). Needs a drop/queue guard in the key path. Not a regression from current work; pre-existing latent race.

apps.name: OpenCalc
apps.flow: Calculate, copy result, resize and close.

evidence.detail: Mapped screenshot and clean close observed; controls remain mostly blank and useful calculation/copy/resize flow is unverified.

Keypad renders (949x995 table, 5x199px rows, 237px buttons, 244 colors); display band fixed via layout-direction resolution (HSV1 949x178, HSV2 949x83; cursor + input glyphs + history visible). tasks.title: Pin three target apps and useful flows

evidence.detail: All three pinned apps launch windowed exit 0 with real content paths: OpenCalc keypad+display render, input reaches evaluator (log-visible); Calculator computes 2+2=4 via tap injection; Notes Main renders editable field with typed text (headless). No flow fully passes live: OpenCalc equals/copy blocked app-side (Gson store/Syntax error), Notes/Calculator live input blocked on compositor focus race.

Desktop-bridge endpoint moved out of the work tree: <work>/run/<pkg>/bridge.sock exceeded sun_path for deep work dirs (111/134 bytes in the OpenCalc runs), so the daemon failed to bind and desktop integration silently disabled itself. The endpoint is now /tmp/isakai-<uid>-<digest16> (mode 0711, launcher-owned, verified not group/other writable) shared by launcher, privileged helper, Landlock grant and the in-sandbox JNI client (src/bridge/path.zig). Launcher logs bridge readiness and the daemon logs accepted client uids. Verified: deep-work-dir OpenCalc launch now shows "desktop bridge ready" plus "bridge: client uid 1000 connected"; runtime probe connects under Landlock. A real flow harness (verify-isakai/flow-drive.py) now drives pinned apps with per-action window-focus verification.

Flow harness hardened from live runs: compositor focus is re-verified before every keystroke and press, pointer placement is self-calibrating (the uinput absolute axis is ~2x the screen and the model drifts, so each observation updates the estimate), presses verify the cursor did not move during the hold, the keypad boundary is detected from the captured frame so blind presses stay in the display area, the expected result is read from the app's own stored history, and foreign input (the user's keyboard) aborts the run instead of corrupting evidence. Workspaces are made visible via hyprctl dispatch (the eval form silently no-ops).

Harness fixes from live runs: copy-sweep guard now accepts the recorded result as legitimate input state (the app logs its own result as an equation line); isolated-env SWAYSOCK resolves the live sway IPC socket instead of a stale PID-suffixed path. Calculation is verified end to end repeatedly (typed 12+34, app history records 12+34->46, visible result screenshots, exit paths clean).

tasks.acceptance: All three app records have immutable APK identity and repeatable visible interaction plus persistence assertions. At least one includes internal screen navigation and one includes Unicode editing.

tasks.title: Add APK compatibility diagnostics

evidence.detail: All three pinned APKs have JSON static reports; seeded missing method, ARM-only library and unsupported opcode diagnostics pass. Runtime logs retain original constructor/lifecycle errors. Reachability and unsupported-call coverage remain incomplete.

Runtime report now retains nested causes and separate thread failures, with bounded symbolic stack locations and no ordinary exception payloads. Seeded nested NoSuchMethodError and redaction regression passes. Legacy capability shells are still only partly instrumented.

Regenerated machine-readable static linkage reports for all three pinned APKs using existing translated classes, with the current Notes runtime log. Reports explicitly do not assert fresh translation, reachability, or support; unresolved class/member findings remain numerous. Seeded compatibility diagnostic checks pass.

tasks.acceptance: Each pinned APK yields a machine-readable report (tools/compat-report.py); seeded ABI, missing-method and unsupported-opcode failures identify the relevant class/method or library and a useful next action.

tasks.title: Implement the main-thread message queue

evidence.detail: Stable owning-thread queue, monotonic delays, cancellation, FIFO/front ordering, bounded nonrecursive dispatch, quit and queued Choreographer fallback pass Java regressions. Live navigation fixture verification underway. Real mapped Wayland navigation fixture passed worker-to-main dispatch, delayed screen changes/results, deterministic lifecycle and clean shutdown.

tasks.acceptance: Worker-posted main callbacks run on the UI thread; delayed callbacks do not run early; cancellation works; self-rescheduling callbacks do not recurse; queue identity is stable and shutdown terminates cleanly. Proven via visible UI behavior.

tasks.title: Support in-app activity navigation

evidence.detail: Real mapped Wayland fixture passes explicit same-package launch, Unicode intent extras, result, back/finish lifecycle order and main-thread dispatch. Pinned target screen flows still fail on missing framework APIs.

Notes/Calculator Splash activities do launch Main via the Navigator in live windowed runs (no ActivityNotFoundException in window logs); the blank screenshot is because Splash finishes itself (finish() sets backPressed), so the observed frame is the empty Splash content, and headless navigation probes of Notes Main hit the translated-AppCompat 'Theme.AppCompat' gate plus isakai.dataDir attachment. Explicit cross-activity navigation for the pinned flows needs either AppCompat theme support or a probe path that survives it.

Theme handoff unblocks Splash->Main navigation for Notes (headless probe: active=MainActivity, full lifecycle OK). The AppCompat gate was a framework theme-propagation gap, not an app defect: manifest themes reach only the launcher activity via IsakaiMain argv, and Navigator.launch never forwarded them.

Real Wayland navigation fixture reproduced missing launch intent extras with a NullPointerException. Navigator now snapshots/delivers the intent before onCreate and resolves destination activity themes from staged manifest metadata instead of inheriting the launcher activity theme. Added reduced manifest/intent regression. Live fixture passes Unicode extras, activity result, lifecycle order, main-thread callback ownership, per-screen screenshots and attachment cleanup. Real APK settings/back and state restoration flows remain unverified.

Compositor close requests are now honoured: a kind-10 event finishes the activity instead of being dropped. Before this, the compositor destroyed the surface, the next frame post failed with "ConnectionClosed" and the app died with IllegalStateException (OpenCalc exit 1). Painting now treats a closed connection as "window gone": the loop exits and the handle is closed in the finally block (OpenCalc exit 0 under observe-app).

Correction to the earlier close-request note: portal/notification close events (kind 10) are NOT the compositor toplevel close and must not finish the activity — treating them as such closed the app when a notification was dismissed (observed as an early exit). Reverted; the toplevel close already arrives as window.run() == 0 and ends the loop. The paint-side fix stays: a frame posted to a destroyed surface ends the loop and closes the handle instead of throwing, so the close-vs-paint race exits 0 (OpenCalc under observe-app).

tasks.acceptance: A target opens a second screen, passes data, returns a result, and navigates back without destroying the app unexpectedly or duplicating lifecycle calls. Proven visibly on device windows.

tasks.title: Make target layouts and text usable

evidence.detail: OpenCalc keypad layout measures correctly after TableLayout/ImageView AOSP-semantics fixes: TableLayout 949x995, five visible rows 199px each, buttons 237px wide with centered labels. Verified via live windowed screenshot (grey grid, full-window content) and headless measure probe. Display/scroll areas still blank: HorizontalScrollViews measure 949x0 (0.0dp height) and inner history panel needs adapter data; separate from the keypad fix.

Implemented recursive host-window attachment/detachment and shared window tokens, onSizeChanged callbacks, focused-descendant lookup, coalesced zero-desktop-inset delivery/listeners, and parent-controlled hierarchy state saving/restoring. Fixed compiled XML visibility enums (0/1/2) and numeric orientation values; Notes locked overlay was incorrectly visible. Added behavioral regressions. Notes now populates its editor page in a reduced tree probe, but real screenshots remain blank/poorly rendered; useful editing/persistence acceptance is NOT established.

Added Display.getRefreshRate and made the live observation helper retry compositor focus. Fresh OpenCalc, Calculator, and Notes windows now all capture and exit 0; visual evidence shows OpenCalc/Calculator controls and a Notes editor/card surface. Real editing, persistence, and resize behavior are still not proven.
evidence.command: python3 verify-isakai/observe-app.py 0 --work .cache/isakai/recheck/opencalc6 --startup-timeout 240; python3 verify-isakai/observe-app.py 1 --work .cache/isakai/recheck/calculator2 --startup-timeout 240; python3 verify-isakai/observe-app.py 2 --work .cache/isakai/recheck/notes --startup-timeout 240

evidence.detail: Real long-press delivery landed: View.onTouchEvent arms a delayed check on the main queue (postDelayed now defers instead of running inline; View.postDelayed/removeCallbacks share one main Handler so removal matches the queued message), cancels on slop/cancel/up, and setOnClickListener/setOnLongClickListener now imply clickable/long-clickable as AOSP does. Regression: android.view.LongPressTest (arm, click suppression, slop cancel, removed listener). OpenCalc copy still does not complete: its result row is laid out at 0,50,949,75 while the containing HorizontalScrollView sits at 0,93,949,134 with an 8px-wide inner LinearLayout, so the result text is clipped out of the painted frame and pointer hit-testing lands on the container, not the result TextView. That layout/measure defect (same family as the recorded "HorizontalScrollViews measure 949x0") is the next target.

RelativeLayout now solves rules instead of stacking children: AOSP verb ids, rule parsing from attributes (layout_toRightOf/below/alignParent*/centerInParent/start-end/margins), parent alignment, sibling relations, centering, absolute parent offsets, deterministic missing-anchor and cycle handling, and generateLayoutParams/checkLayoutParams so inflated params keep their rules. Regression: android.widget.RelativeLayoutTest (13 placements + attribute parsing). Pinned-app layout acceptance still needs the OpenCalc result-row defect (clipped/unhittable display row) investigated.

Coordinate-system unification: framework layouts (LinearLayout, FrameLayout, RelativeLayout, ViewGroup base) now place children parent-relative like AOSP and translated containers; View.drawAt/onDrawAt/dispatchDrawAt compose root offsets down the tree; ViewGroup touch dispatch offsets events into child frames. Fixes Calculator keypad taps (2 renders, C clears) and 8px->32px toolbar items. OpenCalc still renders correctly after the change (full flow green).

Closed three measured live-flow framework gaps: TextView.setCursorVisible/isCursorVisible (default true, gates EditText cursor paint), View.sendAccessibilityEvent(int)/Unchecked plus ViewParent.requestSendAccessibilityEvent default (AOSP-shaped, no-ops honestly while the manager reports disabled), and EditText touch delegation (DOWN now flows to the standard press/long-press machinery instead of focus-only short-circuit; behavior unchanged unless the app opts into long-click). All three NoSuchMethodError crash sites from live runs are gone; the flow proceeds crash-free to the copy step.

EditText.onTouchEvent now delegates DOWN to the standard press/long-press machinery instead of focus-only short-circuit (behavior unchanged unless the app opts into long-click). This unlocked the OpenCalc copy step: a touch long-press on the result field fires the app's copy listener. Proven by a full isolated flow PASS via the touch path; a repeat PASS went through the keyboard path (Ctrl+A/Ctrl+C).

tasks.acceptance: Target screenshots have usable bounds and no overlapping controls; input, cursor movement, copy/paste and saved Unicode text match expectations after resizing and reopening.

tasks.title: Close measured translator and framework failures

evidence.detail: Resolved measured Notes startup blockers: DatabaseErrorHandler and exact SQLiteOpenHelper constructor, onConfigure, WAL/version APIs, atomic migrations with rollback; drawable tint for solid SRC_IN, bitmap-backed Canvas, preserved layer-list IDs and drawable attributes. Actual production-confinement probe passes Unicode SQLite writes, reopen/version persistence and failed migration rollback. Target Notes now reaches ImageView.setColorFilter and MediaDataSource failures; Calculator reaches drawable resource 0x7f0801ba failure. OpenCalc opens/closes but remains largely blank; a prior intermittent nPost error needs continued observation. None of the three useful app flows has passed. Further traced Calculator drawable 0x7f0801ba to unhandled ripple XML; static content/mask inflation now succeeds and actual startup advances to missing android.view.Gravity. Ripple animation remains explicitly unavailable.

Fixed measured Notes launch blocker: Intent.removeExtra returned Intent, but translated app bytecode calls AOSP descriptor (Ljava/lang/String;)V; changed to void (no framework callers chained). Notes Splash now launches windowed, exit 0, no exceptions. Fixed OpenCalc blank window (two root causes, both AOSP-semantics divergences): (1) TableLayout measured MATCH_PARENT rows at full parent height, overflowing the vertical weight pass so WRAP rows clamped to EXACTLY 0 — now forces TableRow children to WRAP_CONTENT per AOSP TableLayout.measureVertical, rows share 995px evenly (5x199px); (2) drawable-free WRAP_CONTENT ImageView (menu button 0x7f09014e) measured full parent via default View.onMeasure and painted white over siblings — added AOSP ImageView.onMeasure (no drawable = intrinsic 0), menu button now 0x0. OpenCalc window now shows grey button grid with labels (244 colors, content bbox full window). Added regressions: IntentSignatureTest (void descriptor), TableLayoutMeasureTest, ImageViewMeasureTest; 14/14 framework tests pass. Calculator Gravity/setColorFilter/MediaDataSource/drawable failures were stale (already fixed). Remaining: Notes/Calculator Splash->Main navigation blocked on AppCompat theme check in translated AppCompat (needs framework answer), so C1 flows still unverified; OpenCalc display area still blank (adapter-driven panel, separate issue).

Fixed in-app navigation theme propagation: Navigator.launch now hands the caller's manifest app/activity themes to the new Activity (Activity.attachTheme + Context.baseThemeForNav); previously MainActivity had no theme and translated AppCompat threw 'You need to use a Theme.AppCompat theme' during Splash->Main navigation. Headless probe with the fix: Splash navigates to Notes MainActivity, lifecycle OK, content tree measures (toolbar 949x25, search EditText 949x25, ViewPager 949x1036). Live Notes window still renders blank: same content renders 0 non-white pixels headless (empty toolbar/text, not a draw-path failure — EditText with 'hello' renders 187 pixels). Next: drive text input into the live window to prove the note flow; window vanishes under wtype focus-steal need care (close via compositor races input). OpenCalc input echo still unverified (display-band diff showed size-mismatch noise only).

Drove OpenCalc calculate flow live: typed 12+34= via wtype; app logs Equation BigDecimal 1/12/12+/12+3/12+34/12+34= and Unexpected = (parsed but = unhandled in expression path), clean exit 0 via Escape. Fixed framework gaps the flow exposed: View.awakenScrollBars+scrollbar enable (RecyclerView history), ViewGroup.getFocusedChild, Color.colorToHSV/RGBToHSV/HSVToColor (CardView), View.setClipToOutline/getClipToOutline/setOutlineProvider (CardView), android.text.format.DateUtils incl. build.zig registration (history timestamps), View.hasFocusable + ViewGroup override, View.onScrollChanged wired into scrollTo, Canvas.drawRoundRect(RectF/floats,Paint) with FILL/STROKE, ViewGroup attach/detach scrap-cache + addFocusables/focusSearch/onRequestFocusInDescendants/requestChildFocus/offset rects/getChildDrawingOrder (RecyclerView/LinearLayoutManager). Fixed key dispatch: ViewGroup.hasFocus recurses into descendants and dispatchKeyEvent follows hasFocus (was isFocused, never true on parents) — keys now reach nested EditText (KeyDispatchTest, 15/15 pass). Remaining: display area blank in screenshots (HorizontalScrollViews measure 949x0 from 0.0dp height); result visible only in logs; copy/resize sub-flows not yet driven.

Fixed OpenCalc display band: MarginLayoutParams now tracks layout direction (get/setLayoutDirection) and resolves at addView (attach) and View.layout, matching AOSP; translated ConstraintLayout copies guide fields (a/b/c->m0/n0/o0) only inside resolveLayoutDirection, which the framework never called, so guidelines stayed at 0 and the 0.0dp scroll views collapsed to 949x0. After fix (single pass): HSV1 949x178 at y8-186, HSV2 949x83 at y186-269. Live calc drive now shows display content: cursor line pre-input, input glyphs + history text post-input (calc2.png bands y8-16, y84-96). Added LayoutDirectionTest (16/16 pass). Live Notes: tap path fixed (ViewGroup.isChildrenDrawingOrderEnabled/setChildrenDrawingOrderEnabled, View.getZ/setZ); headless tap+type renders (field 386px, text hello notes) but live window needs compositor focus that races close; preshot/typed still 1-color without focus. Remaining: Notes/Calculator live input focus, OpenCalc copy/resize, solver ArrayIndexOutOfBounds noise (caught+logged, exit still 0).

Calculator calculate flow verified headless via tap injection: Splash->Main navigation (AppTheme 0x7f12000c), keypad rows measure (5x~141px), tapped 2+2= through dispatchTouchEvent, result display=4, formula=2+2. Fixed gaps: ViewParent nested-scroll defaults (NestedScrollView.onInterceptTouchEvent), OverScroller.springBack, View.getZ/setZ, ViewGroup drawing-order-enabled flag. Live Calculator window still needs compositor-safe input (wtype races close; observe preshot shows 233-color content). Notes live input has same focus race; headless tap+type renders (386px).

OpenCalc equals/copy path analyzed: typed 2+2 reaches display (Equation BigDecimal logs), but equalsButton evaluates through a Gson-backed expression store (c1.d.b parses JSON, not raw text) and yields result Syntax error both via direct equalsButton() call and = button tap. Direct c1.d.b("2+2") throws Expected BEGIN_ARRAY but was STRING — the app-side store format, not a framework gap; copy/resize sub-flows blocked on the app producing a result. Calculator fixed gaps this round: ViewParent nested-scroll defaults, OverScroller.springBack. Notes fixed gaps: ViewGroup drawing-order-enabled flag, View.getZ/setZ; Notes headless tap+type renders text (386px).

Resolved margin direction is now stored by resolveLayoutDirection, and replacement layout params are resolved before onMeasure (not only attach/layout). Regression covers RTL replacement params before measurement. All 16 Java test programs pass. Regenerated inventory (483 production Java sources); repository graph/path/doc/inventory checks pass. zig build returned exit 0 after global-cache permission approval. Real pinned-app visible flows were not rerun for this change; C6 and C7 remain incomplete.

evidence.detail: New regreuse differential DEX case reproduced integer sentinel comparison using stale object slots after a terminated throwing block; translator now prioritizes reaching integer definitions. Full oracle passed 17 corpus cases plus two line-table checks. The fix emits JVM ConstantValue attributes for byte/short/char/int/boolean static values. OpenCalc ConstraintLayout's static capacity field now initializes correctly; its prior ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException no longer appears during a fresh launch.

evidence.detail: Reproduced Calculator's Drawable.tint warning at w7.j.S bci=221 on VectorDrawable; its fillColor was @0x106000b, unsupported by ColorStateList. Added filled-path vector rendering for M/L/H/V/C/S/Q/T/A/Z, group transforms/clips, alpha compositing and SRC_IN/stateful tint; ColorStateList now resolves numeric @0x... color refs. VectorDrawableTest covers absolute/relative lines, cubic/quadratic/arc paths, transforms, clipping, alpha, stateful tint, system color lookup, and missing-ID rejection. Full core gate passes: 37/37 Zig steps, 21 Java programs, 17 DEX corpus cases plus line checks, runtime confinement, compatibility diagnostics, APK limits, and packaging. Fresh Calculator startup exits 0 without Drawable.tint/VectorDrawable.fillColor warnings. Screenshot unchanged from baseline; no calculation/settings/restart flow rerun, so C6/C7 remain in_progress. Vector strokes, trim paths, gradient fills, generic color filters, LayerDrawable parent tint, and non-SRC_IN tint remain incomplete.

Closed measured translator/framework failures from live OpenCalc runs: android.animation.ValueAnimator.getInterpolator (RecyclerView item animator died with NoSuchMethodError), Animator/ValueAnimator state (duration/delay/repeat/frame delay/evaluator/duration scale/pause-resume listeners), ViewPropertyAnimator.setListener (returning the animator), View.hasTransientState/setHasTransientState. Regressions: android.animation.ValueAnimatorApiTest plus the 24 existing Java programs. OpenCalc now runs its RecyclerView layout without exceptions (previously two NoSuchMethodError crashes per launch).

Vector strokes and trim paths implemented (previously emitted as unsupported): strokeColor/strokeWidth/strokeAlpha/strokeLineCap/strokeLineJoin/strokeMiterLimit outline the geometry through java2d BasicStroke and paint as a separate pass (fill preserved), and trimPathStart/trimPathEnd/trimPathOffset cut the flattened geometry including wrap-around trims. The rasterizer samples 2x2 per pixel so a 1px stroke on a pixel boundary is not missed. tasks.title: Harden media for a selected app

evidence.detail: Confirmed defect fixed: IsakaiMedia read stdout and stderr to EOF before waitFor, so a decoder that never wrote could not be timed out. All host processes now go through one supervisor with the deadline started before the wait, concurrent bounded pipe draining (stdout capped and fatal on overflow, stderr keeps the tail), forced kill plus reap on timeout/interrupt, and stdin closed so a decoder cannot block on input. Regression: org.isakai.bridge.HostProcessTest (hung child times out, pipes separated, stderr tail cap, exit text, overflow kill, stdin EOF). Streaming PCM playback/state machine and content URIs remain open.
